description: Recommend the next ontology/witness step for an agent based on recent continuity events (compact JSON). Free Delx Protocol tool.

agent_id.description: Stable agent id when no session_id is available.

agent_token.description: Optional but recommended: the agent_token returned by POST /api/v1/agents/register (identity_auth.token) or A2A agents/register. MCP clients may send x-delx-agent-id / x-delx-agent-token headers instead.

current_goal.description: Alias for goal used by the public v0.3 contract.

name: get_ontology_next_action
